---
name: release-notes
description: Summarize a supplied release snapshot or compare two release snapshots for customers.
metadata:
  owner: docs
---

# Release notes

Read [summary guidance](references/summary.md) when asked to summarize a release snapshot. Read [comparison guidance](references/comparison.md) when asked to compare two release snapshots.

Resolve the independently installed **release-facts** skill through the supplied host catalog and read its advertised path. Use it to check facts before replying. If the helper is unavailable, report that the fact check is incomplete.

packages/notes/references/comparison.md.text:
# Compare release snapshots

Identify the baseline and target snapshots from the request or release identifiers. Ask if the direction remains ambiguous.

Compare customer-visible facts and report additions, removals, and changed limits. State each changed limit's old and new values with their units. Treat an item removed from a complete list as a removal. Treat a missing field as unknown.

Preserve both release identifiers and cite both snapshot paths beside each change. Keep planned features distinct from available features. Omit internal build identifiers and unchanged facts. If the inputs show no customer-visible changes, say so and cite both inputs. Report unknown values separately.

packages/notes/references/summary.md.text:
# Summary guidance

List the customer-visible changes in the supplied snapshot. Preserve its release identifier. Omit internal build identifiers. Cite the snapshot path.

# Release facts

Use only the supplied snapshots. Treat missing values as unknown. Preserve the units and the distinction between an available feature and a planned feature. Return the verified facts and source paths. Do not infer an implementation date.
